newsitem.title: USA: U. Michigan consumer sentiment final April 101.4.
newsitem.headline: U. Michigan consumer sentiment final April 101.4.

text.p: The University of Michigan's final index of consumer sentiment for April rose to 101.4 compared to 100.0 in the final March index, financial market sources said on Friday.
The current conditions component rose to 115.2 in the final April report against the 109.8 reading in the final March.
The expectations index fell to 92.5 in the April final data versus 93.6 in the final March, the sources added.
The data are released only to paying subscribers.
